_comment: Deterministic perf smoke tests for the gate — import-time budget + endpoint latency budget. Skips gracefully when the package/app does not exist yet, so the gate never deadlocks an empty repo.
name: perf-smoke
description: Deterministic perf smoke tests: import-time budget + /health latency budget. Wired into the security gate's perf-smoke job.

variables.name: package_name
variables.description: Project package to measure (skips if absent)

notes: Skipped (not failed) when the package or FastAPI app does not exist — so the gate passes on a fresh repo and starts measuring as soon as code lands. Tighten budgets as the app matures.
